description: S34 T3's ordinary state: the configured servers exactly as internal/mcp sees them, with tier and declaredBy DERIVED rather than stored — a server under "public" is tier public and declaredBy lists every agent whose declares names a qualified tool under its namespace; a server under an agent's own "private" list is tier private and declaredBy is that one agent (MC2: invisible to every other agent, not merely unauthorized). mcp.status never dials anything on its own (TB9) — probes only ever reflects what T4's mcp.check already cached, which is why this fixture carries one example row (github, checked earlier) alongside scratch's never-checked absence, rather than an all-empty probes object that would teach protogen the wrong shape for the field.
